mysql-79902.title: Direct Reproduction: GREATEST/LEAST with BIGINT UNSIGNED overflow
mysql-79902.expected: GREATEST should return 9223372036854775808 (2^63), LEAST should return 9223372036854775807 (2^63-1). TiDB must preserve unsigned semantics and avoid signed integer truncation.

mysql-79902.title: Variant: GREATEST/LEAST applied to BIGINT UNSIGNED column values
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE t_bigint (a BIGINT UNSIGNED, b BIGINT UNSIGNED);
trigger_sql: SELECT GREATEST(a, b), LEAST(a, b) FROM t_bigint;
mysql-79902.expected: GREATEST should return 9223372036854775808, LEAST should return 9223372036854775807. Tests handling of column-level BIGINT UNSIGNED comparisons in aggregation-like expressions.

mysql-79902.title: Variant: Mixed signed/unsigned argument handling
trigger_sql: SELECT GREATEST(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS SIGNED), CAST(9223372036854775808 AS UNSIGNED));
SELECT LEAST(CAST(9223372036854775807 AS SIGNED), CAST(9223372036854775808 AS UNSIGNED));
mysql-79902.expected: GREATEST returns 9223372036854775808, LEAST returns 9223372036854775807. Verifies that cross-type promotion preserves correctness and avoids sign misinterpretation.
mysql-79902.notes: Tests internal type coercion behavior when mixing SIGNED/UNSIGNED, exposing potential signed-integer fallback in GREATEST/LEAST evaluation.
